introduction.title: How to build a universe
introduction.deck: What must connect an equation to a prediction we can trust? A guide to the physics, mathematics, evidence and open questions of this programme.

general.heading: An equation is a beginning
paragraphs: Suppose someone hands you an elegant equation and says it could describe the universe. Before believing them, you would want to know what it describes, how things change, what can be measured, and whether the predictions agree with observations. An equation alone cannot answer all of those questions.

This programme began with an unusual theory of gravity called Weyl gravity. It grew into a broader investigation: start with the jobs a physical theory must do, then identify which physical ideas and mathematical assumptions make each job possible. We call this reverse foundations of physics. The aim is a clearer route from an interesting idea to a testable claim.

general.heading: The assumptions beneath the answer
paragraphs: A theory begins with physical ideas: how systems affect one another, which changes leave the laws unchanged, and what can count as a measurement. It also chooses a mathematical setting. A finite table of numbers and a space containing every possible wave are different settings, even if one approximates the other.

A further layer concerns what mathematics allows us to assume exists. For instance, better and better finite approximations need a justified connection to a limiting object. Finally, the model needs rules for predictions and probabilities, and a fair comparison with data. Changing any of these layers can change the conclusion.

general.heading: What the 576 cells mean
paragraphs: The atlas crosses six ways of organizing mathematical assumptions, six kinds of mathematical setting, and sixteen jobs a theory may need to perform. Six times six times sixteen gives 576 cells. These are 576 questions, not 576 proposed universes.

A cell might ask whether states can be defined in a particular setting, or whether a limiting prediction can be reconstructed under particular assumptions. Its color reports the kind of evidence recorded there. Even several successful cells do not make a complete theory: the pieces must fit together, and the atlas records missing connections as well as results.

general.heading: Why the distinctions matter
paragraphs: The gravity studies ask several different questions about extra solutions: do they exist mathematically, survive the rules that remove redundant descriptions, remain possible when interactions are included, and support sensible probabilities? The word ghost is often used around these questions, but one answer cannot settle all of them.

Other examples test different connections. Mannheim’s proposal uses conformal gravity to explain how galaxies rotate; comparing its predictions with data requires stating how measurement errors are weighted. A curve can do better by one score and worse by another. A stability shortcut for Bateman and Turok’s proposal for higher-derivative physics can fail without disproving their entire theory. Each case needs a precise question and a conclusion with explicit limits.

general.heading: A simple example of an important difference
paragraphs: Imagine receiving increasingly detailed descriptions of a wave. One supplier gives an error schedule telling you when an approximation is accurate enough. Another only promises that the descriptions eventually agree. Those are different amounts of information, even though the wave and the detector are the same.

The project proves a precise mathematical difference between these two reconstruction tasks. A second example shows why making each finite model pass a probability test can still leave the complete model unresolved or unacceptable under the stated conditions. These are useful bounded lessons about information and limits, not a finished theory of nature.

general.heading: What we have not built
paragraphs: The programme has not produced a complete theory of the universe. A mathematical construction must still connect to meaningful states, predictions, and observations. Failing a proposed route may teach us something important without proving that every route must fail.

There is also a concrete correction to the older introductions: the current full exported gravity construction fails a basic internal consistency check. A partial repair removes the exposed errors, but the complete repaired construction has not been verified. This website therefore does not repeat the older affirmative claim that the full propagation and two-point construction has been established.

general.heading: How to judge AI-assisted research
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems help this programme derive equations, write software, challenge arguments and draft explanations. They can also produce convincing mistakes. Clear writing matters because a reader must be able to see what was assumed, what was checked and where the argument could fail.

The evidence trail therefore links a claim to its calculation and checks. Repeating the same calculation is useful, but it is not the same as checking it independently. A computer proof establishes the statement it was given; it cannot decide whether that statement models nature. Asger Alstrup Palm is the accountable human contact. The work remains open to criticism on its evidence.

general.heading: Choose a question, then follow the evidence
paragraphs: Begin with Questions for a worked example. Use the Dictionary whenever a word blocks understanding; it explains the same idea for different backgrounds, with examples and links between concepts. The reading menu lets you change perspective or compare accounts without changing the topic.

Theory journeys follow a proposal toward a prediction and a test. The Research atlas lets you inspect the 576 questions and their evidence. Papers provide the detailed, dated arguments. You do not need to read the entire matrix first: choose a question, understand what would count as an answer, then inspect the supporting steps.

physics.heading: From equations to physical obligations
paragraphs: The programme combines two questions: whether pure Weyl gravity and related fourth-order models survive their classical, quantum and empirical tests, and which assumptions each test actually uses. The unit of progress is an obligation—such as state existence, causal propagation or a calibrated prediction—rather than a theory name.

The two introductory papers motivate the same decomposition. Physical postulates, mathematical realizations and logical existence principles are distinct inputs. A result about one realization must not acquire a stronger interpretation merely because the notation resembles that of another. This introduction presents that programme, with later corrections incorporated below.

physics.heading: Keep five inputs visible
paragraphs: Separate physical postulates, the carrier used to realize them, logic and existence assumptions, operational identifications, and empirical protocols. Locality or conformal symmetry is a physical premise; a Hilbert completion or an operator domain is mathematical structure; a detector functional and a noise model add different operational information.

The distinction matters at familiar transitions: from finite truncations to continuum fields, from Euclidean constructions to Lorentzian propagation, and from an indefinite gauge description to physical probabilities. Each transition needs a theorem or an explicitly stated premise. A successful calculation on one side does not supply that bridge by itself.

physics.heading: Coverage and composition are different
paragraphs: The six foundational regimes, six carrier families and sixteen obligations form a common coordinate system. A finite algebraic construction, a Hilbert-space argument and a local field-theoretic construction can contribute evidence to different cells without being identified.

Theory profiles show coverage, whereas theory journeys follow assumptions, states, evolution, observables, predictions and empirical tests along one route. A profile may collect strong results from incompatible realizations. The journey asks whether the necessary interfaces have actually been supplied for the same model.

physics.heading: The papers organize several kinds of test
paragraphs: The fourth-order and pure-Weyl studies distinguish local modes, reduction by gauge symmetry and constraints, nonlinear continuation, and quantum interpretation. An additional classical direction is not automatically a negative-probability particle; a positive free block does not automatically extend to an interacting theory.

The empirical studies distinguish unweighted residuals from uncertainty-weighted gates in a bounded galaxy protocol. The Bateman–Turok example targets a proposed universal Euclidean stability estimate rather than the whole reconstruction programme. Each is a case study in specifying which implication succeeds or fails, with the detailed assumptions retained in its paper and evidence record.

physics.heading: Locate the extra requirement
paragraphs: The wave benchmark fixes chiral data and one smeared detector. Supplying a Cauchy rate permits the declared reconstruction in the weak base; removing it yields a stronger existence statement. The lower bound already occurs at a fixed time and profile, so the additional logical cost is amplitude completion rather than propagation.

The reduced tensor-mode example distinguishes a positive correction at each finite cutoff from one smooth correction compatible with all modes and the stated commutator. Its boundary is reduced-model positivity. Neither calculation supplies the full gravity state construction or decides a research programme’s empirical viability.

physics.heading: Current gravity acceptance boundary
paragraphs: The serialized full complex fails its differential consistency prerequisite. The trace/ghost candidate repairs two exposed blocks and selected contraction identities, but full nilpotency, compatible maps and pairing for the repaired object remain unverified. Older claims of an accepted full BRST–Hadamard transfer must be read with this correction.

This failure does not erase every classical or reduced-mode calculation. It blocks conclusions that depend on this full export. A physical positive state, full Lorentzian renormalization and an interacting quantum theory still need their own constructions; neither formal causal structure nor a local quantum calculation can substitute for them.

physics.heading: Separate kinds of evidence
paragraphs: An exact algebraic identity, a numerical benchmark, a written infinite-dimensional proof and a proof-assistant derivation answer different questions. An independent checker is useful only if it does not silently inherit the producer’s decisive assumption. A skip or timeout contributes no passing evidence.

The unusual AI-assisted authorship increases the importance of explicit sources and reproducible arguments. The website is a current explanatory account, while papers preserve dated arguments. Neither fluent prose nor a machine-readable certificate supplies missing physical premises or substitutes for independent scientific review.

physics.heading: Use the route that matches the question
paragraphs: Questions gives the wave and finite-positivity examples; Theory journeys follows assumptions through states, dynamics, observables and empirical gates. The atlas is the specialist evidence interface for comparing carriers and tracing missing joins.

Read the physicist introduction as a dated source for this common introduction, then consult the appropriate specialist paper and current correction. The mathematics perspective explains logical and representation issues without assuming training in reverse mathematics. Comparing perspectives should reveal the same scope, not a different scientific claim.

mathematics.heading: What structures make a prediction possible?
paragraphs: A physical model is more than a differential equation. It needs a space of admissible data, evolution, quantities extracted from solutions, and a bridge to observations. Existence, uniqueness, continuity and probability can depend on different structures and hypotheses.

The project studies that dependency explicitly. Reverse foundations of physics is broader than reverse mathematics: it compares physical premises and mathematical representations as well as logical strength. Its origin in pure Weyl gravity provides concrete problems; the general question is which assumptions suffice for each specified task and which can be proved necessary.

mathematics.heading: The ambient object is part of the theorem
paragraphs: A carrier includes the relevant topology, pairing and operator domains, not merely an underlying set or vector space. A change of topology can change which operations are continuous; a change of pairing can change positivity. A representation of input data can include or omit a convergence rate.

Logical assumptions form another layer. A proof may assert that an infinite set or limit exists without supplying an effective construction. Reverse mathematics studies the strength of such assertions over a fixed base. The wider programme also asks whether another carrier preserves the intended observable while avoiding a particular assumption.

mathematics.heading: A coordinate system for scoped questions
paragraphs: Each cell combines a foundational regime, a carrier family and a physical obligation. The geometry of this table is organizational: neighboring coordinates need not be connected by an implication. A populated cell does not quantify over every object in its family.

The atlas therefore keeps evidence records and interface claims separate. Compare hypotheses and constructions before composing results. A theorem about a finite exact complex can be useful without constituting a theorem about its completion; an existence proof on one carrier need not transport to another.

mathematics.heading: Different mathematical failures have different force
paragraphs: A local solution may fail a global compatibility condition. A nontrivial cohomology class may have no demonstrated positive state interpretation. A family of finite constructions may lack a uniform estimate needed to pass to a limit. These are different obstructions and should have different conclusions.

The introductory papers illustrate this with fourth-order gravity, a Euclidean stability counterfamily, and bounded empirical comparisons. The counterexample to a sufficient estimate does not negate every possible construction; a comparison of fitted residuals does not identify a model without its statistical and physical assumptions.

mathematics.heading: Representation changes the statement
paragraphs: Over RCA₀, the supplied-rate reconstruction WRμ is provable, whereas the rate-free assertion WR is equivalent to ACA₀. RCA means Recursive Comprehension Axiom; ACA means Arithmetical Comprehension Axiom. They name mathematical axiom systems used to calibrate the two assertions, not levels of physical accuracy.

The distinction is in the input representation and the requested fast name for the observable. The scalar completeness reversal is standard; the project realizes it within the fixed wave-detector construction. The cutoff example separately illustrates the logical difference between a correction for each finite stage and one correction with the required uniform regularity.

mathematics.heading: A failed prerequisite blocks its dependants
paragraphs: A complex must satisfy Q²=0 before its claimed cohomology and transfer can be used in the advertised way. The current serialized export has nonzero terms where that identity requires zero. A candidate fixes the diagnosed blocks, but those repairs do not constitute a proof of all identities for the whole object.

The right conclusion is scoped: dependent full-transfer claims remain unestablished by this export. One should not infer that every related classical complex or every reduced calculation is invalid. The website separates the current status from the historical publications and keeps the remaining hypotheses visible.

mathematics.heading: Check the theorem and its encoding
paragraphs: For a formal or computational check, identify the exact object, arithmetic and assumptions that entered the encoding. Finite exact arithmetic can verify a matrix identity without proving an infinite convergence theorem. Replaying a generator demonstrates reproduction; a distinct derivation tests a different failure mode.

The wave reversal illustrates the distinction: its infinite argument is written mathematics supported by independent finite checks, not a completed proof-assistant formalization. Audience editions are also editorial work. Sharing a status record prevents one kind of inconsistency but cannot mechanically prove that every explanation preserves meaning.

mathematics.heading: Move between explanation and formal statement
paragraphs: Use the mathematics perspective to identify objects and hypotheses, the physics perspective to understand what the observable is intended to represent, and the specialist perspective to find the exact contribution and boundary. The dictionary crosslinks concepts rather than requiring a fixed reading order.

For a theorem, follow its statement to the evidence record and source argument. For a proposed composition, inspect the interface as well as the two endpoints. The atlas organizes where to look; it is not itself a proof of every implication suggested by the layout.

specialist.heading: An obligation-based research programme
paragraphs: The synthesis organizes claims as L + S + M + Enc(P) ⊢ O: logic, existence principles, carrier and encoded physical premises support a specified obligation. This is an audit framework, not a single formal metatheorem or a claim that every atlas record has been mechanically formalized.

Pure-Weyl and fourth-order case studies motivate the distinction between algebraic consistency, admissible classical directions, nonlinear continuation, causal construction, quantum positivity and empirical comparison. The living introduction follows Papers 99 and 98 while replacing their superseded full-transfer assertions with the current export boundary.

specialist.heading: Type the interfaces, not only the endpoints
paragraphs: Record which structures a comparison preserves: differential, pairing, causal support, observable identification, positivity, normalization or empirical meaning. A chain map is not automatically a cyclic identification; a causal distribution is not automatically a state; local anomaly cancellation is not a Lorentzian construction.

Dependency tags and lifecycle states prevent these substitutions. LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC, EUCLIDEAN-SPECTRAL, REDUCED-MODE and LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL describe different dependencies. Classification, coefficient calculation, restoration of a local identity and transfer to a residual complex are separate obligations. None alone establishes a complete physical model.

specialist.heading: Read the atlas as a typed evidence index
paragraphs: The 576-coordinate surface indexes scoped local and literature evidence. Coverage envelopes may select different realizations for different obligations; they are not consistent-model existence proofs, viability probabilities or rankings by foundational strength.

Use passports and interface ledgers to inspect the first missing join. Historical grades remain visible for audit, including records whose advertised full export later failed. The current correction on the atlas takes precedence over interpreting those records as accepted end-to-end constructions.

specialist.heading: Read each case at its actual target
paragraphs: The case portfolio separates fourth-order completion and interaction tests, compact and Schwarzschild admissibility, local quantum classification, Euclidean stability estimates, and bounded model-to-data protocols. These targets have different result kinds and cannot be collapsed into one ghost verdict.

In particular, the older introductions’ affirmative full-complex BRST–Hadamard language is superseded by the current export audit. The examples remain useful as an obligation map, but an archived claim is not a current acceptance certificate. Follow the source-specific evidence before using any case as an input to another construction.

specialist.heading: Two bounded results, distinct dependencies
paragraphs: For rational mean-zero chiral step-pair inputs with an ordinary-Cauchy promise, the specified fast polygonal output principle WR is equivalent to ACA₀ over RCA₀. With a supplied tail modulus, WRμ is provable in the base. This is second-order pointwise existence, supported by an infinite written argument and exact finite reduction checks, not a uniform higher-type operator theorem.

The reduced TT cutoff obstruction concerns smooth corrections preserving the specified commutator and short-distance condition. Finite positivity can be repaired cutoff by cutoff while the required smooth control diverges. The result remains conditional and reduced-mode; full off-shell transfer and full physical positivity are separate gates.

specialist.heading: Do not compose past the failed export gate
paragraphs: The current audit exposes 28 metric and 16 trace terms in Q². The 12-coefficient trace/ghost candidate cancels those blocks and passes selected contraction identities; it does not certify the complete repaired differential, chain maps, cyclicity or full causal transfer.

No accepted full off-shell Lorentzian propagator, full BRST-compatible Hadamard state, renormalized Lorentzian time-ordered products, causal perturbative quantum field theory or Lorentzian quantum-master-equation theorem follows here. Residual deformation classes are not one-particle graviton states. Preserve these boundaries when reading older introductory assertions.

specialist.heading: Audit receipts without overreading them
paragraphs: Inspect source commits and hashes, exact-versus-numerical types, verifier independence, mutation tests and declared non-claims. The claim graph should expose failed prerequisites rather than allowing a later-stage label to conceal them. Lifecycle transitions require evidence, not editorial repetition.

AI contributes derivation, implementation and exposition, with an accountable human contact. Neither AI authorship nor a proof-assistant brand settles validity. Review the encoded statement and its connection to the target model; the four website editions are not four independent confirmations.

specialist.heading: A review path through the site
paragraphs: Use the introduction to locate the programme, Questions for bounded worked statements, and the atlas for evidence roles, passports and interfaces. Read current status before relying on archived papers. The specialist edition leads with targets and acceptance boundaries; other editions should communicate the same programme without hiding those boundaries.

A useful review identifies a specific unsupported implication, mismatched type, missing premise or incorrect calculation. The framework is intended to make such objections actionable, not to turn a broad coverage map into a claim of completion.

wave.title: When does an approximation justify a prediction?
wave.deck: The same wave and detector, with two different kinds of input information.

general.heading: A wave and a detector
paragraphs: Imagine a wave travelling around a circular track. Our mathematical detector returns a weighted average of the wave over space, rather than its height at one point. The example asks whether increasingly accurate descriptions of the wave determine a well-controlled detector reading.
This is an idealized scalar wave model, not a calibrated instrument or a model of gravitational-wave detection.

general.heading: What information are we given?
paragraphs: Compare two descriptions. The first says that the approximations will eventually settle down. The second also gives an error schedule: for any requested accuracy, it tells us how far to go.
The second description contains extra information. Watching a finite number of approximations agree cannot, by itself, provide that guarantee about every later approximation.

general.heading: What follows?
paragraphs: With the error schedule supplied, the model lets us construct an approximation to the detector reading with controlled error. Without it, the assertion that an appropriate completed reading always exists uses a stronger set of mathematical assumptions in the formulation studied here.
The surprise is where the extra difficulty sits: it is already present in finding a limiting amplitude before the wave moves. Complicated dynamics are not responsible.

general.heading: Why this matters—and its limits
paragraphs: A prediction depends on how its inputs are specified, not only on its equation. This example makes one hidden assumption visible: whether convergence information is part of the data.
It does not show that a physical detector needs stronger logic, nor that every prediction from a wave equation is difficult. It is a comparison of two carefully defined mathematical tasks.

physics.heading: The observable
paragraphs: Take mean-zero left- and right-moving scalar profiles on the unit circle. A fixed periodic tent function h defines Oₚ(t)=∫h(x)[a(x−t)+b(x+t)]dx. Translation supplies the dynamics; spatial smearing supplies a bounded observable.
The model is deliberately simple enough that source representation can be isolated from dynamical complexity.

physics.heading: Two source contracts
paragraphs: Both formulations give bounded rational step-pair approximants satisfying a Cauchy promise in the energy metric. One also supplies a function choosing the index needed for each tolerance. The rate-free formulation supplies no completed state or convergence oracle.

The output is a continuous observable represented by polygonal approximations with a prescribed error rate. A completed input state would already provide missing information and would change the question.

physics.heading: The comparison
paragraphs: With a supplied rate, observable reconstruction is provable over RCA₀. The rate-free existence principle is equivalent over that base to ACA₀, arithmetic comprehension. This is a logical classification of the represented reconstruction problem.
The reversal needs only a fixed spatial profile and the detector at t=0. It therefore does not attribute the stronger requirement to propagation, infinitely many excited modes or chaotic dynamics.

physics.heading: Physical interpretation
paragraphs: The useful lesson is to distinguish finite numerical data, an error-controlled state description, and a bare existence claim. The theorem classifies the last-to-output step for one input contract.

No calibration, stochastic noise model, empirical comparison or full gravitational-field reconstruction is established. The finite detector-recovery benchmark addresses a different question: prediction intervals from specified measurements and an energy bound.

mathematics.heading: Objects and representations
paragraphs: Let D consist of rational periodic step pairs p=(a,b), each component of mean zero. Use the squared distance d(p,p′)²=∫[(a−a′)²+(b−b′)²]. A fixed tent function defines a bounded linear observable of translated profiles.

The input is a coded sequence in the unit ball of D satisfying the ordinary Cauchy condition. The output is a fast uniform Cauchy sequence of rational periodic polygons representing the limiting observable.

mathematics.heading: The missing function
paragraphs: The Cauchy promise has the form ∀k ∃N ∀m,n≥N: d(pₘ,pₙ)²≤2⁻²ᵏ. A modulus supplies a function μ(k) witnessing the existential indices. It is not part of the rate-free input.

RCA₀ supports the coded rate-supplied construction. ACA₀ adds arithmetic comprehension: existence of sets specified by arithmetic formulas. The question is what is needed to obtain the output when only the promise is given.

mathematics.heading: The theorem and its mechanism
paragraphs: Writing WR for the specified rate-free principle, the comparison is RCA₀ ⊢ WRμ and RCA₀ ⊢ (WR ↔ ACA₀). The quantifier is “for every input there exists an output”; no higher-type uniform selector is asserted.

The upper bound extracts suitable indices with arithmetic comprehension. For the reverse implication, a fixed profile transfers scalar limiting-amplitude information to one detector value at time zero. The familiar completeness phenomenon is realized in an explicit wave-observable representation.

mathematics.heading: Scope of verification
paragraphs: Finite rational inequalities and the reduction witnesses have independent computational checks. The infinite reverse-mathematical argument is a human proof, not a proof-assistant-checked theorem.
Neither RCA₀ as a representation-independent weakest base for wave physics nor a general requirement for ACA₀ in physical measurement follows. The exact coding is part of the statement.

specialist.heading: Statement
paragraphs: Over RCA₀, WR ↔ ACA₀ for the rate-free observable reconstruction principle on unit-bounded ordinary-Cauchy sequences of rational mean-zero chiral step pairs. The supplied-modulus version WRμ is provable in RCA₀.

Prerequisites: second-order arithmetic and represented analysis. The scalar completeness reversal is standard; the contribution is its realization in this fixed observable together with the matched rate-supplied formulation.

specialist.heading: Input/output contract
paragraphs: Inputs provide the ordinary Cauchy promise in the squared L² pair metric, without a modulus, completed energy-state name or oracle. Outputs are polygonal names satisfying ‖Aₗ−Aₖ‖∞≤2⁻ᵏ for l≥k, whose limit is the ordinary uniform limit of the input observables.

WR is a second-order ∀input ∃output assertion. Rational-time evaluation and finite polygon comparisons express the required conditions without assuming a function space as a set of all points or a higher-type choice functional.

specialist.heading: Proof mechanism
paragraphs: Uniform boundedness of the observable controls passage from data to output. Arithmetic comprehension supplies modulus information for the upper bound. The reverse reduction is already supported on one fixed spatial profile and a fixed tent detector at t=0.

Thus the lower bound is an amplitude-completion effect, not a propagation obstruction. Read the linked proof for the exact coding and both implications; finite witness checks do not formalize the infinite theorem.

specialist.heading: Boundaries and related material
paragraphs: No representation invariance, general causal Green construction, physical axiom requirement or experimental detector claim is established. Supplying a completed state would alter the input and invalidate the purported rate-free comparison.

The atlas ladder records separate analytic extensions. The finite detector-recovery benchmark is an optimal-recovery specialization under measurement and energy constraints, not evidence for a new reversal.
